audience: construction project teams that track tickets, change orders and site journals in Capmo

useCases.title: Find overdue tickets in a project
useCases.text: List the projects, then the tickets of one project. Open a ticket to read its deadline, cost and company.

useCases.title: Log a new ticket for a defect
useCases.text: List the ticket categories of a project. Then create a ticket with the category id. The status defaults to OPEN.

useCases.title: Change the fields of a ticket
useCases.text: Read a ticket, then change only the fields you pass to the update.

useCases.title: Review change orders and their cost
useCases.text: List the change orders of a project with their cost and step. Open one to read its reason and companies.

useCases.title: Read site journals and project documents
useCases.text: List the daily site journals of a project and open one to see its attendances and visits. List the documents too.
